Groq responses for `tests/unit/test_groq.py`, in the shape Groq's OpenAI-compatible
API returned live on 2026-11-22 (`openai/gpt-oss-120b`): a structured answer, a
tool call, and the 400 Groq sends when gpt-oss "calls" a tool named `json` to
deliver its final answer. Trimmed to the fields AMOS reads.
